newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police hold 17 Kurds suspected of beatings.
newsitem.headline: German police hold 17 Kurds suspected of beatings.

text.p: Bavarian police said on Tuesday they had detained 17 suspected members of the banned Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) which is fighting Ankara's rule in southeast Turkey.

Two Kurdish asylum-seekers, aged 27 and 29, were arrested on suspicion of beating up and seriously injuring a fellow asylum-seeker who apparently refused to pay donations to the party, Munich prosecutors said.

The rest were detained on suspicion of spreading PKK propaganda, police said. All 17 suspects were rounded up at asylum-seekers' homes in the southern German state of Bavaria, where police confiscated PKK stickers, posters and literature.
German prosecutors suspect PKK leaders of being behind a series of arson attacks over the last few years on Turkish properties in Germany. The PKK is also banned in Germany.
